units.rawText: Dakkadakkadakka—
units.displayText: Dakkadakkadakka—

spans.text: Dakkadakkadakka—

units.rawText: Bullets whistle past me, leaving a trail of holes in the nearby wall. I pick up the pace and run between the convoy and the station platform.
units.displayText: Bullets whistle past me, leaving a trail of holes in the nearby wall. I pick up the pace and run between the convoy and the station platform.

spans.text: Bullets whistle past me, leaving a trail of holes in the nearby wall. I pick up the pace and run between the convoy and the station platform.

units.rawText: (Fortunately I completed Python's training course... Now I'm at least capable of holding my own against Faith.)
units.displayText: Fortunately I completed Python's training course... Now I'm at least capable of holding my own against Faith.

spans.text: Fortunately I completed Python's training course... Now I'm at least capable of holding my own against Faith.

units.rawText: (It would be bad if the Seeds of Entropization in the cargo compartments accidentally went off during the battle... In any case, I need to get as far away from the convoy as possible.)
units.displayText: It would be bad if the Seeds of Entropization in the cargo compartments accidentally went off during the battle... In any case, I need to get as far away from the convoy as possible.

spans.text: It would be bad if the Seeds of Entropization in the cargo compartments accidentally went off during the battle... In any case, I need to get as far away from the convoy as possible.

units.rawText: [Switching to melee combat mode, activating Blade of Judgement.]
units.displayText: [Switching to melee combat mode, activating Blade of Judgement.]

spans.text: [Switching to melee combat mode, activating Blade of Judgement.]

units.rawText: Shing!
units.displayText: Shing!

spans.text: Shing!

units.rawText: The excessive amount of obstructions makes Faith abandon the idea of shooting me; instead, she just charges right at me. Her blade stabs right through the signboard I'm hiding behind.
units.displayText: The excessive amount of obstructions makes Faith abandon the idea of shooting me; instead, she just charges right at me. Her blade stabs right through the signboard I'm hiding behind.

spans.text: The excessive amount of obstructions makes Faith abandon the idea of shooting me; instead, she just charges right at me. Her blade stabs right through the signboard I'm hiding behind.

units.rawText: I roll forward to avoid the attack and trigger the landmine I laid there beforehand.
units.displayText: I roll forward to avoid the attack and trigger the landmine I laid there beforehand.

spans.text: I roll forward to avoid the attack and trigger the landmine I laid there beforehand.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!

units.rawText: I use this opportunity to dash up the stairs and create a height difference between us. The explosion throws up a cloud of dust, through which I can see Faith's eyes, burning red like those of a fallen angel and radiating bloodlust.
units.displayText: I use this opportunity to dash up the stairs and create a height difference between us. The explosion throws up a cloud of dust, through which I can see Faith's eyes, burning red like those of a fallen angel and radiating bloodlust.

spans.text: I use this opportunity to dash up the stairs and create a height difference between us. The explosion throws up a cloud of dust, through which I can see Faith's eyes, burning red like those of a fallen angel and radiating bloodlust.

units.rawText: ...Nothing but cheap tricks.
units.displayText: ...Nothing but cheap tricks.

spans.text: ...Nothing but cheap tricks.

units.rawText: Faith jumps straight up and throws her shield. It crashes down in front of me, blocking my way forward.
units.displayText: Faith jumps straight up and throws her shield. It crashes down in front of me, blocking my way forward.

spans.text: Faith jumps straight up and throws her shield. It crashes down in front of me, blocking my way forward.

units.rawText: I am forced to stop. In the next moment, she moves into close range. One hand grabs me by the neck, while the other slams into my stomach—
units.displayText: I am forced to stop. In the next moment, she moves into close range. One hand grabs me by the neck, while the other slams into my stomach—

spans.text: I am forced to stop. In the next moment, she moves into close range. One hand grabs me by the neck, while the other slams into my stomach—

units.rawText: <size=40>Guwaargh!</size>
units.displayText: Guwaargh!

spans.text: Guwaargh!

units.rawText: Incredible pain floods through my brain and all my strength leaves me in that instant.
units.displayText: Incredible pain floods through my brain and all my strength leaves me in that instant.

spans.text: Incredible pain floods through my brain and all my strength leaves me in that instant.

units.rawText: Faith raises her arm. The shield transforms into a blade and returns to her hand. Just before she stabs me with it, I bring my elbow down on the joint between the edge and the hilt.
units.displayText: Faith raises her arm. The shield transforms into a blade and returns to her hand. Just before she stabs me with it, I bring my elbow down on the joint between the edge and the hilt.

spans.text: Faith raises her arm. The shield transforms into a blade and returns to her hand. Just before she stabs me with it, I bring my elbow down on the joint between the edge and the hilt.

units.rawText: The edge bites into my bicep and operands flow down my upper arm. I use the moment when the blade is stuck to roll out of the way and escape Faith's attack range.
units.displayText: The edge bites into my bicep and operands flow down my upper arm. I use the moment when the blade is stuck to roll out of the way and escape Faith's attack range.

spans.text: The edge bites into my bicep and operands flow down my upper arm. I use the moment when the blade is stuck to roll out of the way and escape Faith's attack range.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!

units.rawText: The second landmine explodes and the stairs to the station break about level by level, plunging downward as chunks of debris.
units.displayText: The second landmine explodes and the stairs to the station break about level by level, plunging downward as chunks of debris.

spans.text: The second landmine explodes and the stairs to the station break about level by level, plunging downward as chunks of debris.

units.rawText: I grab my still-aching stomach and crawl out of the debris, searching for a hiding place as operands leak from the wound on my upper arm.
units.displayText: I grab my still-aching stomach and crawl out of the debris, searching for a hiding place as operands leak from the wound on my upper arm.

spans.text: I grab my still-aching stomach and crawl out of the debris, searching for a hiding place as operands leak from the wound on my upper arm.

units.rawText: (That won't stop Faith for long... She'll be after me again soon enough.)
units.displayText: That won't stop Faith for long... She'll be after me again soon enough.

spans.text: That won't stop Faith for long... She'll be after me again soon enough.

units.rawText: (Though I want to get away from the convoy, she's pursuing me like a mad dog and won't give me the chance to open the distance between us...)
units.displayText: Though I want to get away from the convoy, she's pursuing me like a mad dog and won't give me the chance to open the distance between us...

spans.text: Though I want to get away from the convoy, she's pursuing me like a mad dog and won't give me the chance to open the distance between us...

units.rawText: Crackle—
units.displayText: Crackle—

spans.text: Crackle—

units.rawText: My disguise shimmers, and a bad feeling fills my heart.
units.displayText: My disguise shimmers, and a bad feeling fills my heart.

spans.text: My disguise shimmers, and a bad feeling fills my heart.

units.rawText: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.
units.displayText: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.

spans.text: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.

units.rawText: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?
units.displayText: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?

spans.text: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?

units.rawText: Avoid combat, my ass; I'm stuck in a freaking boss fight here...
units.displayText: Avoid combat, my ass; I'm stuck in a freaking boss fight here...

spans.text: Avoid combat, my ass; I'm stuck in a freaking boss fight here...

units.rawText: My disguise slowly fades away, forcing me to pick up the pace.
units.displayText: My disguise slowly fades away, forcing me to pick up the pace.

spans.text: My disguise slowly fades away, forcing me to pick up the pace.

units.rawText: <size=40>Gwaargh!</size>
units.displayText: Gwaargh!

spans.text: Gwaargh!

units.rawText: The intense movement exacerbates the pain and blood loss, and I feel a wave of dizziness wash over me.
units.displayText: The intense movement exacerbates the pain and blood loss, and I feel a wave of dizziness wash over me.

spans.text: The intense movement exacerbates the pain and blood loss, and I feel a wave of dizziness wash over me.

units.rawText: Damn, but Faith can hit hard...
units.displayText: Damn, but Faith can hit hard...

spans.text: Damn, but Faith can hit hard...

units.rawText: But I still have to hang in there...
units.displayText: But I still have to hang in there...

spans.text: But I still have to hang in there...

units.rawText: This isn't just because of those couple of mails I received. For some reason... I feel like everything is riding on this battle. Many people have placed their hopes on me.
units.displayText: This isn't just because of those couple of mails I received. For some reason... I feel like everything is riding on this battle. Many people have placed their hopes on me.

spans.text: This isn't just because of those couple of mails I received. For some reason... I feel like everything is riding on this battle. Many people have placed their hopes on me.

units.rawText: I need to finish all this and go back safely; after all, I still have people waiting for me.
units.displayText: I need to finish all this and go back safely; after all, I still have people waiting for me.

spans.text: I need to finish all this and go back safely; after all, I still have people waiting for me.

units.rawText: If I lose my disguise, not only will Mayuri and Riko be in danger, but the relationship between the Oasis and the Sanctifiers will be threatened. I need to think of something...
units.displayText: If I lose my disguise, not only will Mayuri and Riko be in danger, but the relationship between the Oasis and the Sanctifiers will be threatened. I need to think of something...

spans.text: If I lose my disguise, not only will Mayuri and Riko be in danger, but the relationship between the Oasis and the Sanctifiers will be threatened. I need to think of something...

units.rawText: Ki!
units.displayText: Ki!

spans.text: Ki!

units.rawText: The diminutive Entropic pops out from under my arm and gently pats my chest.
units.displayText: The diminutive Entropic pops out from under my arm and gently pats my chest.

spans.text: The diminutive Entropic pops out from under my arm and gently pats my chest.

units.rawText: Right, good thing I've got you, little guy... That ought to be able to buy a little more time...
units.displayText: Right, good thing I've got you, little guy... That ought to be able to buy a little more time...

spans.text: Right, good thing I've got you, little guy... That ought to be able to buy a little more time...

units.rawText: Crash!
units.displayText: Crash!

spans.text: Crash!

units.rawText: A mighty fist shatters the block of stone above it. The red-haired Sanctifier slowly rises from its remains, the flames of wrath burning even brighter in her heart.
units.displayText: A mighty fist shatters the block of stone above it. The red-haired Sanctifier slowly rises from its remains, the flames of wrath burning even brighter in her heart.

spans.text: A mighty fist shatters the block of stone above it. The red-haired Sanctifier slowly rises from its remains, the flames of wrath burning even brighter in her heart.

units.rawText: You despicable Daemon...
units.displayText: You despicable Daemon...

spans.text: You despicable Daemon...

units.rawText: Her anger does not come from the shame of an Irregular Agent evading her numerous times; rather, the fact that her opponent seems to know how she acts instinctively kindles Faith's fury into an inferno.
units.displayText: Her anger does not come from the shame of an Irregular Agent evading her numerous times; rather, the fact that her opponent seems to know how she acts instinctively kindles Faith's fury into an inferno.

spans.text: Her anger does not come from the shame of an Irregular Agent evading her numerous times; rather, the fact that her opponent seems to know how she acts instinctively kindles Faith's fury into an inferno.

units.rawText: I will make sure to thoroughly cleanse and purify you...
units.displayText: I will make sure to thoroughly cleanse and purify you...

spans.text: I will make sure to thoroughly cleanse and purify you...

units.rawText: That punch just now should have taken out an ordinary agent, and I know it did lasting injury...
units.displayText: That punch just now should have taken out an ordinary agent, and I know it did lasting injury...

spans.text: That punch just now should have taken out an ordinary agent, and I know it did lasting injury...

units.rawText: Drops of operands spatter the ground nearby, pointing to the location of her target.
units.displayText: Drops of operands spatter the ground nearby, pointing to the location of her target.

spans.text: Drops of operands spatter the ground nearby, pointing to the location of her target.

units.rawText: The request for support has been acknowledged. More Sanctifiers will be here soon... They won't get far.
units.displayText: The request for support has been acknowledged. More Sanctifiers will be here soon... They won't get far.

spans.text: The request for support has been acknowledged. More Sanctifiers will be here soon... They won't get far.

units.rawText: Faith silently raises her shield and jogs down the trail of operands.
units.displayText: Faith silently raises her shield and jogs down the trail of operands.

spans.text: Faith silently raises her shield and jogs down the trail of operands.
